A1.limit: A limit printed with every label: these are read-time changes to memories trained under the registered read. The tree's values and output projection were trained with the prior in the weights and two branches visited. A read-time change that does not help does not show that training without it would not; one that helps shows only that the trained content tolerates it. Causes that act during training need Stage B.

r_diagnosis_loaded.note: R-DIAGNOSIS-LOADED has no combination rule and enters nothing; its labels recommend nothing; 'restored' there means restored to a full store

readings.accuracy_version: RULING 3 (ADR section 19): acc0 is the memory-disabled accuracy of the same checkpoint and panel (P10-S1's own panel_counts; the frozen backbone's, identical for every checkpoint of a draw); the accuracy version of the retention ratio is printed beside each comparison and decides nothing
readings.cell_dependent: RULING 1 (ADR section 19): two CELL-DEPENDENT values are the same only if they hold the same row at each primary cell; otherwise the component is CHECKPOINT-DEPENDENT and R-CONFIRM is NOT CONFIRMED
readings.fully_row3: READING: row 3 is FULLY if T1 and T3 are both RESTORED on both panels, else PARTLY
readings.index_gate_scope: §11 and §16 item 11: a failure of I256@512 or of an I64 index with F0 passing voids the index label of the replicate only; study-level NOT EVALUABLE (§9 item 1) applies per component's primary cells
readings.mainly: READING: 'mainly weights' / 'mainly selection' compares i(T1w) - i(T0) with i(T1) - i(T1w), each the mean of the two panels; equal is printed 'equal'
readings.median_c_star: READING: a cell's c* is the statistics.median of its replicates' c* (those that have one); with an even count this is the mean of the two middle values
readings.missing_plateau: READING: a replicate whose recorded snapshots do not allow the plateau check counts as failing it
readings.mixed_cell: READING: MIXED is a value that two primary cells can share; the component is then MIXED and recommends nothing
readings.mixed_panel_cell: RULING 2 (ADR section 19): a cell with four MIXED-PANEL replicates is MIXED (a MIXED-PANEL replicate satisfies no condition); MIXED-PANEL is a replicate row only
readings.panel_closure: ADR §16 item 10 (ruled as recommended): P, C and J need the condition on both panels; a closure on one panel only is not P, C or J
readings.slack: CONVENTION: every comparison of i with a threshold (gap, RESTORED, closure, H, R, plateau, floor) allows an absolute slack of 1e-12 (labels.EPS): a value within 1e-12 of a threshold counts as on its inclusive side; i comes from integer counts, so no real value lies that close
readings.weak_reference: READING: a WEAK REFERENCE (i(F0) below the floor on either panel) makes the replicate NOT EVALUABLE for the label concerned (row 1 / index NOT EVALUABLE); no row is assigned
